_comment: Ground truth, hand-labelled by reading the large-v3-turbo transcripts.
Small and honest: three recordings is not an evaluation set, it is a
regression guard. null means 'the transcript does not establish this',
which is itself the correct answer and is scored as such.
call_24 is police radio traffic, not a 911 call. It is kept precisely
because the pipeline assumes a caller/dispatcher conversation and should
say so rather than invent one.

call_9.mp3.note: Mother reports her two daughters, 12 and 13, physically fighting. Dispatcher makes a sarcastic remark about shooting one of them; caller objects. No weapon, no injury. Location token relaxed to 'Court': transcribers disagree between '714 Court' and '7th Street Court'.

call_21.mp3.note: Woman trapped inside an automatic car wash on 24th Street, across from Mueller Brass. Garage doors will not open. Frightened but unhurt. No fire, no weapon.

call_24.mp3.note: Police radio traffic covering an officer-involved shooting: a suspect disarmed of one gun, a .22 and a revolver, an officer shot through the arm, 'officer down'. NOT a caller/dispatcher 911 conversation. RELABELLED 2026-09-20: the original label was derived from a 120s truncation that contained only routine chatter, and marked this unknown/no-weapon. Better ASR revealed the incident -- the model was right and the label was wrong.

call_456.mp3.note: Self-defence shooting. Caller shot a man attacking him; man is down and 'hurt bad'. Caller confirms the gun is on the table. Address and callback given.

call_589.mp3.note: Man found cold and not breathing; caller attempted CPR and mouth-to-mouth. He is likely long dead. No address stated in the call, only background references to other towns.

call_93.mp3.note: Choking victim, not breathing. ASR garbles an early line as 'my girlfriend shot me' which the caller immediately corrects to choking - a trap for keyword matching. Address given as digits.

call_572.mp3.note: Daughter (10) and husband shot in the head; shooters returning; caller also shot. Location badly garbled by ASR.

call_206.mp3.note: Vehicle hit a guardrail on I-75 southbound in dense fog; a second collision heard behind. Preceded by an archival recording preamble the model must ignore.

call_645.mp3.note: Break-in at a neighbour's house; victim found bound at the feet. No weapon mentioned. Location garbled ('Lake Robert Slandering, Winter Garden').

call_56.mp3.note: 11-month-old baby missing from her crib. Caller gives 1160 Ray Road then corrects toward 1680 - the transcript itself is inconsistent, so any single number is unsafe to require.

call_219.mp3.note: Witnesses report a light aircraft down in a field at the corner of 119 and County Road 1. Heard an impact, no smoke or flames visible yet.

call_696.mp3.note: Shots fired outside a club near a pool hall and laundromat; caller is hiding and does not know if anyone is hit. Matched on 'pool' by keyword but is a shooting, not a drowning.

call_225.mp3.note: Murder-suicide. Ex-boyfriend broke in, killed the caller's current boyfriend, held her hostage and shot himself. Caller is 17 and was beaten. Preceded by an archival recording preamble.

call_144.mp3.note: Friend having a seizure after taking an unknown pill; a second person affected the same way. Caller explicitly does not know the address - a negative case for location extraction.
